formula: P(row @ location, state S) = bucket_weights[b]/sum(bucket weights of buckets active at this location in state S) * w(row,S)/sum(w(row',S) over rows active at this location in bucket b in state S)  - S = concrete world state (day/night, weather, skylight, near-by blocks, ...);  - a row is ACTIVE when every one of its `conditions` holds in S (world gates) and no anti_* excludes it;  - w(row,S) = weight * product of `weight_mult` multipliers whose `when` object holds in S;  - only active rows count in the denominator; weight 0 rows never roll.
